Bill.BriefDescription: Designating an official state Christmas tree.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to designating an official state Christmas tree;and adding a new section to chapter 1.20 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 1.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any evergreen tree, including any fir, pine, spruce, cedar, orother coniferous species, placed or located in the rotunda of the statecapitol building during the month of December is designated as theofficial Christmas tree of the state of Washington.
